item.description: ### Fixed - **Devin: a permission prompt you answer in Devin itself no longer stays as "needs you".** Pressing Escape or Deny in Devin's own prompt now clears the row in Perch and on your iPhone. - **OpenCode 2: finished sessions no longer linger.** Perch now lists only OpenCode sessions that are running or waiting for you, drops archived ones, and clears an idle one after ten minutes instead of an hour. - The OpenCode mark is now black and white, like OpenCode's own logo.
